confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of South Korean price levels, not checked against live menus, listings or booking sites. Restaurant and cafe anchors are the most reliable; July peak-season hotel and hostel rates and the won-to-dollar conversion carry the most uncertainty. Beer assumes a 500 ml draft glass. Cocktail and wine were set relative to the draft beer anchor because direct recall is weaker. The FX value comes from a web-search snapshot of the RBA page, not a separate page read.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis within South Korea: Seoul is the upper reference for dining and hotels, and other large Korean cities are the closer reference for everyday restaurant and cafe prices. Accommodation reflects summer beach-season demand in districts such as Haeundae and Gwangalli.
